recipes.name: Saucy Beans on Garlic Toast
ingredients: ¼ cup unsweetened soy Greek-style yogurt
instructions: Add the garlic and oil to a small bowl. Stir.
Use a silicone pastry brush to brush the garlic oil onto both sides of the bread. Transfer the bread to a large pan over medium heat and allow to toast until lightly golden on both sides.
To a small pan over medium heat, add the ingredients for the "saucy beans". Cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Spoon the beans over the garlic toast and serve with a dollop of yogurt and some pickled jalapeño if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Also known as haricot beans. † The chipotle sauce we use is a blend of chipotle peppers with water, vinegar, and spices. It's a deep red-coloured sauce. Some chipotle sauces are mayo-based, and we do not recommend using these versions in this recipe.
Storage This recipe is best enjoyed immediately. The saucy beans can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
